description: This Java class 'CompoundInterestHelper' calculates interest for multiple posting periods in a savings account context within the Fineract project. It sums interest earned over periods, considering account lock dates and interest transfer flags.

classes.name: CompoundInterestHelper
classes.description: Helper class for calculating compound interest over multiple posting periods in savings accounts.

methods.name: calculateInterestForAllPostingPeriods
methods.description: Calculates total interest earned across all posting periods, considering account lock date and interest transfer status.
